content: प्रयोगः .²1 Use, application, employment; as in शब्दप्रयोगः, अयं शब्दो भ्रिप्रयोगः - अल्पप्रयोगः ‘this word is generally or rarely used’. .²2 A usual form, general usage. .²3 Hurling, throwing, discharging, (<ab>opp.</ab> संहारः); प्रयोगसंहारविभक्तमन्त्रम् <ls>R. 5. 57</ls>. .²4 Exhibition, performance, representation (dramatic), acting; देव प्रयोगप्रधानं हि नाट्यशास्त्रम् <ls>M. 1</ls>; नाटिका न प्रयोगतो दृष्टा <ls>Ratn. 1</ls> ‘not seen acted on the stage’; आ परितोषाद्विदुषां न साधु मन्ये प्रयोगविज्ञानम् <ls>Ś. 1. 2</ls>. .²5 Practice, experimental portion (of a subject); (<ab>opp.</ab> शास्त्र ‘theory’); तदत्रभवानिमं मां च शास्त्रे प्रयोगे च विमृशतु <ls>M. 1</ls>. .²6 Course of procedure, ceremonial form. .²7 An act, action. .²8 Recitation, delivery. .²9 Beginning, commencement. .²10 A plan, contrivance, device, scheme. .²11 A means, instrument; नयप्रयोगाविव गां जिगीषोः <ls>Ki. 17. 38</ls>. .²12 Consequence, result. .²13 Combination, connection. .²14 Addition. .²15 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) A usual form. .²16 Offering, presenting. .²17 .³({%a%}) Principal, loan bearing interest. .³({%b%}) Lending money on usury; प्रतिबन्धः प्रयोगो व्यवहारोऽवस्तारः … … कोशक्षयः <ls>Kau. A. 2. 7. 26</ls>; also कोशद्रव्याणां वृद्धिप्रयोगः .²18 Appointment. .²19 A sacred text or authority. A text which brings together the various धर्मs of a विकृति. A प्रयोगवचन, however, does this only when धर्मs are made available by the चोदक which, therefore, is said to be the stronger of the two. चोदको हि प्रयोगवचनाद् बलवत्तरः . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 5. 1. 8</ls>. .²20 A cause; motive. .²21 An example. .²22 Application of magic, magical rites. .²23 A horse.
